summary.text: Dometic RUC5208X, RUC6408X and RUC8408X are compressor refrigerators for 12 V or 24 V DC and 100-240 V AC mains, operated with a control knob and display. Faults show as a red banner with a numbered code across the middle of the display, plus a beep when the fault stops cooling.

models.text: The 2019 Installation and Operating Manual covers the RUC5208X, RUC6408X and RUC8408X compressor refrigerators, for 12 V or 24 V DC and 100-240 V AC mains.
Dometic's current manual for RUC5204X, RUC6404X and RUC8404X describes 12 V / 24 V DC models with an LED panel, ON/OFF button, MODE button and temperature button.
Check that the voltage on the type plate matches the power supply, and that operating voltage and battery voltage match before the first start-up.
The refrigerator cools to +8 °C to 0 °C and the freezer to -10 °C to -20 °C; the unit withstands a short-term inclination of 30°.

display.text: Faults are indicated by highlighting the middle section of the display with a red banner and a code; faults that stop the complete cooling function also beep.
With multiple faults the error code rolls; the beep lasts 2 minutes and repeats every 30 minutes until the fault is restored.
The code table gives each code's type (Warning or Error), whether the icon flashes, whether it beeps, and whether cooling is affected.
Door open more than 2 minutes: a beep sounds with a flashing warning code and turns off after the door is closed.
Mute the beep once with a short press of the control knob, or permanently with the mute icon in the settings menu.
A blue snowflake means the compressor is on, white means off; after 3 minutes idle the screen goes to standby with a snowflake, but stays on while an error is active.
RUC5204X/6404X/8404X: faults are shown by the error warning LED together with other LEDs; battery-low and compressor-related faults flash the warning LED 1x to 5x.

reset.text: Error type faults must be reset manually by pressing and holding the control knob between 2 s and 4 s; Warning type faults reset automatically once the condition passes.
Dometic support: press the encoder button for 3 seconds until you hear a beep; holding it too long turns the refrigerator off without resetting the error.
Switching on or off takes a press of the control knob for more than 3 seconds; the refrigerator restarts with the last selected settings.
RUC5204X/6404X/8404X: press and hold the ON/OFF button for 2 s; a beep confirms the reset. Turning the refrigerator off and on again will not reset the fault.

checks.text: Display dark, terminal voltage 0 V: restore the battery-to-electronics connection; the manual also lists a faulty main switch (if installed) and a blown supply-line or internal fuse.
Terminal voltage at or below the cut-in voltage: charge the battery.
No cooling with an error indicator: fix loose cables or corroded contacts, replace a battery with too little capacity, or replace cable that is too thin or too long.
Battery protection switches the refrigerator off at 10.4 V (12 V) or 22.8 V (24 V) and back on at 11.7 V or 24.2 V.
Connect as directly as possible to the battery poles, fused on the positive side at 15 A (12 V) or 7.5 A (24 V), with cable cross-section sized to cable length.
Voltage present but compressor not starting: ambient temperature too high, insufficient ventilation, dirty condenser or defective fan; clean the ventilation and condenser.
Compressor runs a long time: wait until large loads of unfrozen goods are frozen, defrost an iced evaporator, and adjust or replace a moist door seal.
Compressor does not run often: battery capacity exhausted; charge the battery.
Leave at least 10 mm between the contents and the ventilation openings on the vent cover.
RUC5204X/6404X/8404X battery low (below 10.9 V or 22.7 V, warning LED 1 flash): charge the vehicle battery and switch on the vehicle ignition.
RUC5204X/6404X/8404X poor cooling: check no grille or roof vent is blocked and door seals fit; if the compressor is below 0 °C, cover the external vents with insulation.

parts.text: The code table names the defrost NTC sensor, refrigerator air NTC sensor, ambient thermostat sensor, inner fan, defrost heater, outer fan, compressor and controller unit.
Defective compressor (open circuit between its pins), integrated mains adapter, faulty control sensor or an internal-fault shutdown: only an authorised repair centre can repair these.
Polarity-reversal electronics protect the refrigerator against reversed polarity and short circuits when connected to a battery.
The refrigerator compartment has automatic cyclic defrost; the freezer needs manual defrosting once frost exceeds 3 mm.
RUC5204X/6404X/8404X fault LEDs name the Fresh NTC1, Defrost NTC2 and Ambient NTC3 sensors, mainboard-HMI communication, door reed, internal fan, condenser fan and compressor controller.

callTech.text: No cooling with power present and display lit: defective component, which only an authorised repair centre can repair.
Compressor runs constantly on the warmest setting: control sensor faulty; only an authorised repair centre can repair it.
If a code persists after the owner check and reset, Dometic support says it can only be repaired by an authorized service provider.
If the refrigerant circuit is damaged: avoid naked flames and sparks and air the room well; never open the refrigerant circuit.
Repairs only by qualified personnel; a damaged power cable must be replaced by the manufacturer, customer service or a similarly qualified person.
RUC5204X/6404X/8404X compressor startup, controller overload or overheat and condenser fan overcurrent faults: reset, and contact an authorized service agent if the error occurs again.
